26-005 Notice of Intent to Participate - Kinetic GPO

Post Date
January 6, 2025
Updated Date

Closing Time

Between January 1, 2026 – December 31, 2026, vendors are advised the Regional District of Nanaimo (RDN) intends to utilize one or more procurements conducted by Kinetic GPO. For further information and to access the Kinetic GPO opportunities, please visit https://www.kineticgpo.ca/.
